label: Sleep less
blurb: Up at five instead of six, and the last hour of the night given to the desk. It works for a while.

label: Give up the day off
blurb: Monday is the priest's Sabbath. The brother priests notice when you stop coming to dinner; so does the part of you that needed it.

label: Skip the gym and the walk
blurb: The body keeps its own accounts. You will look tired in a year and be tired in two.

label: Stop reading for yourself
blurb: The novel on the nightstand, the journal you subscribe to, the hour of something that is not work.
